mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vehicle (vehicle_id, name, active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{vehicleId}, #{name}, #{active}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT vehicle_id, name, active, created_at, updated_at FROM vehicle WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM vehicle WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId}
mapper.update: UPDATE vehicle SET active = #{active}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId}
mapper.select: SELECT vehicle_id, name, active, created_at, updated_at FROM vehicle WHERE active = true ORDER BY vehicle_id

SELECT v.vehicle_id, v.name, v.active, v.created_at, v.updated_at FROM vehicle v JOIN vehicle_current_status s ON s.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id WHERE v.active = true AND s.position_x IS NOT NULL AND s.position_y IS NOT NULL ORDER BY v.vehicle_id
SELECT vehicle_id FROM vehicle WHERE active = true ORDER BY vehicle_id
